items: 2 large broccoli heads, cut into bite size pieces
2 Tbsp white or yellow miso paste

steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and add rigatoni.
3-5 minutes before pasta is al dente, add in broccoli and allow it to boil until pasta and broccoli are cooked.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain pasta and broccoli.
In the same saucepan, warm EVOO over a medium heat, then add miso paste, garlic, pepper and chili flakes and saute for 30-45 seconds.
Fold in parmesan, rigatoni, broccoli and ¼ cup of pasta water.
Stir to create a glossy coating, adding more pasta water if needed and serve immediately.

recipe_info.title: Broccoli Miso Pasta
recipe_info.intro: Quick and simple broccoli pasta with a glossy miso sauce.
